XVII INDIAN EXPEDITION
TO ANTARCTICA (1997- 1999)
HOW THE THINGS ROLLED
02 Dec 97, Tuesday - Ship MV POLARD BIRD arrived at Marmugao Port.
08 Dec 97, Monday - 1600hrs - Farewell at ASC, GOA.
Chief Guest : Dy. CM of Goa, Dr. Wilfred D'Souza.
- 1900hrs - Flagged off by Dr. AE
Muthunay agam, Secretary.
11 Dec 97, Thursday - 23hrs 45min 52 sec(IST )Equator crossed. (26' 4l'"E)
13 Dec 97, Saturday - 1000hrs - Presentation of XVII IAE Scientific and
Logistic program by members commenced
1700hrs - Tournaments inaugurated.
16 Dec 97, Tuesda y - 0900hrs - Reached Mauritius.
17 Dec 97, Wednesday - 1200hrs - Lunch hoisted by Indian High Commissioner,
Mr Mani  Tripati.
1400hrs - Visit of Telecom conformation.Minister,
Mauritius, Hon.' Sarat Dutt Lallan on board ship.
18 Dec 97,' Thursday - 0930hrs - Visit, Dy.  P M of Mauritius, Mr. Kailash
Purryag.
Two Australian Jayro Helicopter arrived on board ship
20 Dec 97, Saturday - 1215 hrs left Mauritius and  continued voyage to
Antarctica
24 Dec 97, Wednesday - 2000hrs- X'mas eve party.
25 Dec 97, Thursday - X'mas Day.
0208hrs(GMT), crossed roaring 40 deg. South.
Sea bird Albatross sighted at 1430hrs.(37.28S, 46.57 E)
2200hrs time retarded by one hour (total - 3.5hrs)
26, 27 Dec 97 - Rough sea, rolling and pitching, poo r visibility.
28 Dec 97, Saturda y - 0141hrs crossed furious 50 deg S. Very rough sea.
2200hrs, time retarded by one hour ( total - 4.5 hrs)
30 Dec 97, Tuesday - 0330 hrs first ice berg sighted. Very rough sea.
2200hrs time retarded by  one hour { total - 5.5 hrs)
31 Dec 97, Wednesday - 0330 hrs crossed screaming  60 deg South.Rough sea,
rolling and pitching. New Year Party.
1 Jan 98, Thursday - NEW YEAR DAY. Greetings from Bharat Ratna (Dr)
APJAbdulKalam, SA,Hea d of Orgns, Directors & 
others
1600hrs - Ship near polar ice. Penguins sighted.
02 Jan 98, Friday - Ship 5 nm away from India Bay. Helicopter assembly.
298
03 Jan 98, Saturday  - First  helicopter test flight at 1346hrs.
Courtesy visit to Maitri. (Flt started at 1455hrs and
reached Maitr i at 1548hrs)
04 Jan 98, Sunday - 0900hrs- first load to Maitri by underslung.
16 members shifted to Summer Camp ( Mr. MJ
D'Souza, GSI as Summer Camp Commander
assisted by  Mr.Premkishore, NGRI)
06 Jan 98, Tuesday - 1455hrs - courtesy visit to Russian Stn, Novolazarevskya.
12 sorties for shifting of men and material.
08 Jan 98, Thursday - Field Camp at DG and 2 camps at Western
Schirmacher Oasis established.
09 Jan 98, Frida y - Established GSI Field Camp at Humboldt Mountains.
11,12,13 Jan 98 - No flight from Ship due to bad weather.
14 Jan 98, Wednesday - Pongal. Biological field camp closed down.
15 Jan 98, Thursday - E'mail link established with new satcom terminal.
Army Day. Celebration at Maitri. German camp
established.
17 and 18 Jan 98 - No flight due to bad weather.
19 January, Friday - New water pipe line (w/o trace heater) tested for
leakage.
22 to 26 Jan 98 - No flight due to bad weather.
26 Jan 98, Monday - Republic Day. Seismological Lab inaugurated by
Mr. Alexander Kondratiey, Leader,42 Russian
Antarctic Expdn
28 Jan 98, Wednesday  - German camp closed down. GSI team returned from
ship.
29 Jan 98, Thursday - First Sun set after 13 Nov 97 at 2255 hrs.
31 Jan 98, Saturday - GSI field work (drop point at mountains-250 km away)
01 Feb 98, Sunday - No flight due to  bad weather.
02 Feb 98, Monday - Corner reflector experiments at mountain ranges-
Germans
03 Feb 98, Tuesday - No flight due to  bad weather.
04 Feb 98, Wednesday - Ship along side - India Bay.
05 Feb 98, Thursday - JU field camp closed down.
06 Feb 98, Friday - Mauhling Hoffman mountain ranges recce by GST.
07 Feb 98, Saturday - German field camp established at glacier.
08 & 09 Feb 98 - Shifting of fuel from ice shelf to DG.
12, 13 Feb 98 - Blizzard, wind 40 to 80kn
15 Feb 98, Sunday - Shifting of fuel to DG completed (handled approx 1.2
kl fuel)
First batch of Scientists (summer ) returned
299
to ship.
16 to 19 Feb 98 - No flight due to bad weather. Wind 40 to 70 kn.
22 Feb 98, Sunday - 1100 hrs. Handing/Taking over of Maitri.
25 Feb 98, Wednesday - Summer camp closed down.
26 Feb 98, Thursday - First combined convoy left Maitri at 0530 hrs.
02 to 05 Mar 98 - Heavy snow fall, bad weather, wind speed up to 62 kn.
07 Mar 98, Saturday - First combined convoy returned safely at 0300 hrs.
08 Mar 98, Sunday - Celebration on the success of first convoy.
09 Mar 98, Monday - 1010 hrs, last helicopter sortie for XIV WOT members.
1415 hrs. Ship MV Polar Bird return voyage.
XV WOT - Wintering period starts
12 Mar 98, Thursday - Holi.
14 Mar 98, Saturday  - Lake completely frozen.
18 Mar 98, Wednesday- 100 days completed after leaving GOA.
19 Mar 98, Thursday - First convoy with 7 vehicles left at 0550 hrs.
22 Mar 98, Sunday - 12 hrs. equal day and night.
Ship MV Polar Bird reached Mauritius.
23 Mar 98, Monday - World Meteorological Day. Ship left Mauritius.
25 Mar 98, Wednesday- First  Aurora sighted. Convoy returned safely at
2330hrs.
